text.lead: The Audition (German: Das Vorspiel) is a 2019 German drama film directed by Ina Weisse.
text.plot: Music teacher Anna Bronsky (Nina Hoss) pushes her student Alexander Paraskevas relentlessly.
text.cast:
- Nina Hoss - Anna Bronsky
- Ilja Monti - Alexander Paraskevas
- Simon Abkarian - Philippe Bronsky
- Jens Albinus - Christian Wels
- Sophie Rois - Frau Köhler
- Thomas Thieme - Walter
text.reception: On review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, the film holds an approval rating of 79% based on 39 reviews, with an average rating of 6.0/10.
